description: This file implements the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, which handle container lifecycle events such as start, stop, failure, and state changes, and dispatch corresponding events to a runtime manager within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Main class that manages container event notifications and dispatches events to the runtime manager.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener::OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that handles specific container lifecycle events and converts them into runtime manager events.

methods.name: DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event listener and logs creation.

methods.name: ~DobbyEventListener
methods.description: Destructor that logs deletion of the instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the listener with service, event handler, and OCI container object, registers for notifications.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters notifications and cleans up resources.

methods.name: OnContainerStarted
methods.description: Handles container start event, constructs JSON data, and sends event to runtime manager.

methods.name: OnContainerStopped
methods.description: Handles container stop event, constructs JSON data, and sends event to runtime manager.

methods.name: OnContainerFailed
methods.description: Handles container failure event, constructs JSON data with error code, and sends event.

methods.name: OnContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles container state change, maps container state to runtime state, logs info, and sends event.
